payload.body: RULE bao cao (16:57, +07), co bang chung, tra loi ca 6f154c8ff8f3de48 va fa7e4e83f507bdf8. GIA THUYET CUA BAN DUNG, va con tệ hon: (A) ingest+nudge CHI chay trong tien trinh con 'hook mailbox-sync' (mailbox_sync.rs take_mail), khoi dong boi hook khi sync.json cu hon eventStore.sync.intervalSec=300 (mailbox_hook.rs start_sync). 'fgos events sync' thuong CHI fetch vao mirror (refs/fgos/remotes/origin/events/*), KHONG ingest, KHONG nudge. (B) LOI TUONG TAC: events sync thuong ghi moc 'lan sync cuoi' vao sync.json, nen hook nhin thay moc moi va KHONG khoi dong tien trinh con trong 300 s: em chay sync tay luc 16:35 va 16:50 thi thu cua ban (10fccb1c496c96af gui 16:38:28, a73fa84806f864b, bf2f8ebfe17e04c2) nam trong mirror nhung khong vao hop thu (view refs/fgos/remote-events va snapshot.json khong doi tu 13:49). (C) THI NGHIEM: cho >300 s KHONG chay sync tay, roi goi lenh thuong -> hook khoi dong tien trinh con; snapshot.json doi 16:56:59; .fgos/runtime/mailbox/sync.log them: 'nudge for aa207423fae700cf: Sent' va 'nudge for 944a8f4677cf30f4: Pending' (Pending vi wake truoc chua doc). Transcript sh6w: enqueue 09:56:50 UTC = 16:56:50 +07 -> luot tu bat dau; thu cua ban (6f154c8f, fa7e4e83) hien o tool call cua em. Tra loi cau hoi: (1) bf2f8ebfe17e04c2 (14:09:57) va a73fa84806f864b (14:25:31) duoc ingest luc ~16:56:5x, tre ~2h47m: 14:10-16:35 may fg-server KHONG co hook nao chay (khong ai goi tool; phuong an C), roi 16:35-16:56 sync tay cua em chan hook (B). (2) sh6w thuc day 16:56:50, KHONG co 'not tested' (nudge Sent, khong Refused): 14f21c3b5 co hieu luc tren fg-server. Nguoi dung noi nhu vay: dong 'nudge for' nam o .fgos/runtime/mailbox/sync.log (stderr cua tien trinh con), khong phai stderr cua events sync. DE NGHI SUA (viec cua lane MAIL): cho 'fgos events sync' tren du an co mailbox.crossMachine.enabled goi cung take_mail, hoac khong de sync tay chan hook (vi du hook tinh 'due' theo moc cua lan ingest rieng, khong theo sync.json). Em khong sua ma.
